idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Agent
idea-plugin.description:
DeepSeek Agent — chat with your project

Embeds chat.deepseek.com into a tool window and bridges it with the IDE. The model can request file reads, targeted edits, writes, directory listings, text searches, and shell commands — the plugin executes them inside the current project and feeds the results back into the chat.

Tools the model can call

  • read_file("path"[, "startLine-endLine"]) — read a file or a line range
  • edit_file("path", "old", "new"[, "all"]) — targeted in-place replacement
  • write_file("path", "content"[, "append"]) — full rewrite or append (capped at 5 MB)
  • list_files("path") — list a directory
  • search_text("needle") — grep across the project
  • bash("command") — run a shell command in the project root

Key features

  • Batch tool calls — multiple tools per turn, all results in one block
  • Auto-throttling, iteration cap, and automatic recovery from rate limits
  • Placeholder filtering on both JS and Kotlin sides
  • System preamble injected into the first message of every new chat

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3 (build 253) or newer
  • Web Browser (JCEF) plugin enabled
  • On Linux/Wayland: add -Dawt.toolkit.name=XToolkit to custom VM options for clipboard support
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.4

  • Delivery state machine (idle/stream/tools/send/verify/cooldown) with a post-send verify window
  • Automatic recovery from send errors: clicks the chat's retry button or re-sends the text
  • Adaptive send interval: 2500 ms base, 7000 ms backoff after a rate limit, decayed on success
  • Separate cooldowns: 20 s for rate limits, 3 s for other send errors; rlMaxWaits = 8
  • Tool results batched again: all calls from one turn are executed together and returned as a single [TOOL_RESULT] message
  • Injected script renamed __dsAgentV3 -> __dsAgentV4
  • README brought in line with ToolRunner.kt and MyToolWindowFactory.kt

1.2.3

  • read_file(path, "startLine-endLine") — read a specific line range; large files show the beginning plus a hint
  • write_file(path, content, "append") — append, auto-inserting a newline if the file didn't end with one
  • MAX_WRITE_CHARS raised from 500 KB to 5 MB

1.2.1

  • isMessageFinalized now scans all message-level toolbars, not just the first match
  • Toolbar threshold raised from 3 to 5 buttons to avoid confusing code-block toolbars

1.2.0

  • Streaming tool results delivered in completion order with a 1.5 s inter-message delay

1.1.9

  • Version bump to refresh plugin metadata

1.1.2

  • Automatic retry of lost [TOOL_RESULT] after a rate limit
  • 30-second cooldown with auto-resume instead of a hard stop
  • Extended rate-limit detection patterns
  • White DeepSeek icon on the tool window sidebar
  • Extended plugin page description
  • Full English README

1.1.1

  • Placeholder path filter in ToolRunner
  • Whitelist for known tools in parseToolCalls

1.1.0

  • edit_file tool for targeted in-place replacements
  • Multiple tool calls per turn (batching)
  • System preamble injected into the first message of new chats
  • Auto-loop safeguards: throttling, iteration cap, rate-limit detection

1.0.0

  • Initial release: read_file, write_file, list_files, bash, search_text
  • JCEF-based DeepSeek chat in a tool window
  • JS ↔ Kotlin bridge via JBCefJSQuery
